summary.headline: Number of Brothers
summary.text: Chapter XIII explains how to judge the number and birth order of brothers from the ascendant’s triplicity lords, angular places, intermediate infortunes, the third sign and its lord, and the part of brothers. It also distinguishes paucity, mediocrity, or weakness of brothers and uses fortunes between the midheaven and ascendant to signify living brothers.
